mapper.sql: r.id AS `cursor`, r.refund_no AS refundNo, r.order_no AS orderNo, r.member_id AS memberId, r.amount AS amount, r.currency AS currency, r.status AS status, r.approval_ref AS approvalRef, r.approval_deadline AS approvalDeadline, r.policy_version AS policyVersion, r.version AS version, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.business_no AS businessNo, o.business_no AS orderBusinessNo,r.approval_business_no AS approvalBusinessNo
FROM tc_refund r JOIN tc_order o ON o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND o.id=r.order_id
mapper.select: SELECT i.component_type AS componentType, i.order_item_id AS orderItemId, i.quantity AS quantity, i.amount AS amount FROM tc_refund_item i WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND i.refund_id=#{number} ORDER BY i.id
